$description: Per-component semantic version registry for Agentica. Independent from the library-wide release version (package.json) — each component ships its own version, shown on its Figma documentation header (doc/section-header-main-component) and usable on the site. Not a design token: lives outside tokens/ deliberately, since it tracks release history, not design decisions.
rule: Bump a component's version on any change to its tokens, markup contract, or behavior (see .claude/rules/git-workflow.md commit types: feat/fix/token/a11y). Purely editorial doc changes do not require a bump.
